summary: Full backend + frontend validation of new TPV/POS module. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests pass covering gating (403 for basico user, 200 for admin, admin toggle flip flow), settings validation, categories/products (incl. variants + stock, category delete detaches products), tables CRUD (open_ticket_id surfaced), cash session (single-open guard, movements validation, expected_cash summary), retail sale (mixto: base 16.53 / iva 3.47 / total 21 / cash 5 / card 16, stock 10->8; tarjeta: cash 0 / card total), refund replenishing stock, hostelería open comanda + update + pay (stock decrement only on pay) + delete-open-only, receipt HTML at 80/58mm. Frontend: /pos loads, sidebar TPV nav visible, Ajustes save Hostelería/58mm reveals Mesas tab, create category+product from UI, Caja shows session (already open) and withdraw works updating expected cash to 46,00 €, Vender adds product (cart total 5,00 €), Cobrar -> Efectivo -> Confirmar -> SaleDone dialog with Imprimir button, Ventas tab lists 5 tickets, Admin /admin table shows pos-{email} TPV button which toggles (toast 'TPV desactivado para demo_pricing@example.com' visible).

design_issues.screen: POS dialogs (Product, Category, Table, Checkout, SaleDone, Movement, Close)
issues: Radix Dialog warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' — a11y improvement: add DialogDescription in each modal.

action_items: (Optional a11y) Add <DialogDescription> to POS dialogs to silence Radix warning and improve screen reader UX.
critical_code_review_comments: pos_routes.py `require_pos` grants access based on user.get('pos_enabled') stored in the JWT/user doc; toggle takes effect immediately for new logins (verified in test). No issue.
`_compute_ticket` treats unit_price as PVP con IVA (documented in code); base = gross/(1+rate/100). Rounding to 2 dp verified.
`delete_category` sets `category_id: None` on affected products — verified.
`refund_ticket` correctly restores stock and refuses re-refund (status becomes 'refunded').
Minor: `list_tables` iterates tables in Python to attach open_ticket_id — acceptable for small N; consider aggregation if scales.
Missing DialogDescription on multiple Radix Dialogs (a11y warnings).
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral TEST_* categories/products/tables/tickets created and cleaned up. Admin's existing open cash session was reused (as noted in context).
context_for_next_testing_agent: POS module fully validated. Admin session is persistent and shared per company; some TEST_ tickets remain in the sales history (paid + refunded + open-then-deleted comandas). Reverted settings to retail/80mm at end of tests. If retesting, be aware /api/pos/session/open returns 400 when a session is already open (expected).
